actions.convert_file.description: Convert a file to another format with any of ConvertAPI's converters, such as Word to PDF or PDF to JPG. Extra file inputs (like a template or overlay file) are not supported here; use Custom API Call for those.
actions.convert_file.props.additionalFil: Files to add after the main one, for converters that combine files.
actions.convert_file.props.from.descript: The format of the file you are converting.
actions.convert_file.props.options.descr: Options of the chosen converter. Leave empty for the defaults.
actions.convert_file.props.to.descriptio: What to convert the file into.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.merge_pdf.description: Combine several PDF files into one PDF, in the order you list them.
actions.merge_pdf.props.bookmarksTableOf: Add a top-level bookmark for each merged file.
actions.merge_pdf.props.fileName.descrip: Merged file name, without the extension. Leave empty for a default.
actions.merge_pdf.props.files.descriptio: Add the PDFs in the order they should appear. At least two are needed.
Rotate every page to this orientation, or keep the original.
actions.merge_pdf.props.pageSize.descrip: Scale every page to this size, or keep the original size.
actions.merge_pdf.props.password.descrip: Only needed if the PDFs are password-protected. Used for every file.
actions.split_pdf.description: Split a PDF into several PDFs by page count, page ranges, single pages, matching text or bookmarks.
actions.split_pdf.props.fileName.descrip: Base name for the parts, without extension. Each part gets a number.
actions.split_pdf.props.mergeOutput.desc: Join the parts back into one PDF, e.g. to extract selected pages.
actions.split_pdf.props.mode.description: How the PDF is cut into parts.
actions.split_pdf.props.password.descrip: Only needed if the PDF is password-protected.
actions.split_pdf.props.value.descriptio: What to split on. The format depends on the Split By mode.
actions.split_pdf.props.valueHelp.descri:
**Split Value** by mode:
- **Page count**: pages per part, e.g. `5`, or a repeating pattern such as `3,2`. Leave empty for one file per page.
- **Page ranges**: one part per range, e.g. `1-3,5,7-9` gives three files.
- **Single pages**: each listed page becomes its own file, e.g. `1-2,5` gives pages 1, 2 and 5.
- **Text match**: a regular expression; a new part starts at every page whose text matches, e.g. `Invoice\s+#\d+`.
- **Bookmarks**: leave empty.
auth.description:
To get your API token:
1. Sign in to [ConvertAPI](https://www.convertapi.com/a).
2. Open **Authentication** (https://www.convertapi.com/a/authentication).
3. Copy an existing **API Token**, or create a new one, and paste it here.
description: Convert, merge and split documents, images and PDFs with 300+ file converters.
